kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتأنجل (form IIq)
# نَتَأَنْجَلُ (nataʔangalu) /na.ta.ʔan.ɡa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# نَتَأَنْجَلَ (nataʔangala) /na.ta.ʔan.ɡa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# نَتَأَنْجَلْ (nataʔangal) /na.ta.ʔan.ɡal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
